title: A Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
authors: Edward Farhi, Jeffrey Goldstone, Sam Gutmann
abstract: We introduce QAOA, a shallow-depth quantum algorithm for finding approximate solutions to combinatorial optimization problems on NISQ quantum processors.
fullExcerpt: QAOA applies alternating layers of a problem Hamiltonian and a transverse mixer Hamiltonian to an initial equal superposition state. As the number of layers p increases, the approximation ratio converges to 1.

precomputedClaims.claim: QAOA achieves provable approximation bounds on Max-Cut graphs.
precomputedClaims.sourceQuote: A quantum approximate optimization algorithm produces good approximate solutions.

openGaps: Classical optimizer parameter landscape can suffer from non-convex local minima.
